query_text: Gamini Perera was allotted Lot A depicted in Partition Plan No. 2525 dated 2 February 1981 by a final decree of a partition case entered in the District Court of Homagama. Gamini Perera, by Deed of Gift No. 515 dated 10 March 1986, gifted Lot A absolutely and irrevocably to his son, Suresh Perera, subject to the life interest of Gamini Perera and his wife Vinitha. Gamini Perera died in 1990. Vinitha revoked her life interest by Deed of Revocation in 1991. Suresh Perera married Kanthi and had two children, Rakitha and Muditha. Muditha died in 2023 unmarried and issueless. Rakitha married Ann and died in 2022. Suresh Perera died in 1995 intestate, and had an offspring named Samantha from his first marriage. Draw up the pedigree showing the devolution of title from Gamini Perera up to the present owners in relation to the land.
